1	# Protocol B (r1) — minimal, neutral scoping of candidate norm-provenance channels
2	
3	**Goal (from QUESTIONS.md):** decide, for a *bounded* list of locally checkable, read-only
4	channel types, whether any could be an **independent** record of *which norm was in force at
5	time t*. "Independent" = controlled by someone/something other than (a) the norm-maker,
6	(b) the executor of the work, (c) the ruling asserting its own effect. Existence/scoping only —
7	**no archaeology**, no evidence acquisition, **never a forced negative**.
8	
9	The research programme's own artefacts (`docs/knowledgeos/**`) are **never** candidates
10	(self-contamination) and are excluded by the classifier and from E.
11	
12	## 1. Candidate channels (exact patterns)
13	
14	| Id | What | Path pattern / source (case-insensitive) |
15	|----|------|-------------------------------------------|
16	| `K-CI` | CI definitions | `.github/workflows/**`, `.gitlab-ci.yml`, `Jenkinsfile`, `.circleci/**`, `azure-pipelines.yml`, `.drone.yml`, `bitbucket-pipelines.yml`, `.woodpecker*` |
17	| `K-HOOK` | repo-shipped git hooks | `.githooks/**`, `.husky/**`, `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, `lefthook.yml`, `.lefthook.yml` |
18	| `K-CODEOWNERS` | ownership / branch-protection hints in repo | path basename `CODEOWNERS` |
19	| `K-STATUS` | status register / rulings register / in-force record (**outside** `docs/knowledgeos/`) | doc-like ext (`md,markdown,txt,rst,json,ya?ml,toml,csv,tsv`) whose path matches a token in {`program_status,status,ruling(s),register,registry,decision(s),adoption,approval(s),signoff(s),progress,inforce,norm`}, e.g. `docs/implementation/PROGRAM_STATUS.md` |
20	| `K-DEPLOY` | deployment / config **state** | path token in {`deploy,deployment,release,environment,env,infra,terraform`} or ext `tfstate` |
21	| `K-SIG` | signed commits / tags | **presence** of `gpgsig` header / `-----BEGIN (PGP\|SSH) SIGNATURE-----`; keyring **not** consulted, signatures **not** verified |
22	| `K-LOCALHOOK` | local hooks (`LOCAL_ONLY`) | `.git/hooks/<standard-name>` present, or `core.hooksPath` set |
23	
24	**Host-side channels — `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY`** (host not authorized): `K-HOST-AUDIT`
25	(server audit logs), `K-HOST-BRANCHPROT` (branch-protection *enforcement*), `K-HOST-PR-APPROVALS`
26	(PR approvals), `K-CI-RUNS` (CI run history), `K-HOST-MEMBERS` (org/team membership).
27	
28	**The one tip set (B1, N5, N12).** Every history query (paths, W, commit counts, E, N_c, K-SIG)
29	runs over **one** tip file via `git log --stdin` / `git rev-list --stdin`. Tips = refs under
30	`refs/heads/**`, `refs/remotes/**`, `refs/tags/**` only (`refs/stash`, `refs/notes/**` excluded);
31	tags are peeled (`^{commit}`), and **only commit-type tips** are kept. The result does not depend
32	on the checked-out HEAD. Paths are read with `ls-tree -r -z` (N9).
33	
34	## 2. Deterministic answer rules
35	
36	Scope = the **tip set only**; completeness vs the host is never shown. `ND` =
37	`NOT_DETERMINABLE_BY_EXISTENCE_CHECK`, `IND` = `INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE`. If a path channel
38	has **0** paths in the tip trees → Q1 = `NOT_EVIDENCED_AT_TIPS` (it may still exist in history
39	behind the tips) and Q2..Q8 = `NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)`; same label for `K-SIG` when no signature is
40	present in commits reachable from the tips or in tag objects at the tips; `K-LOCALHOOK` uses
41	`NOT_EVIDENCED_LOCALLY`. Host rows are `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY` for all eight.
42	
43	- **Q1 exists** → `YES_IN_CAPTURE` | `YES_LOCAL_ONLY` (`K-LOCALHOOK`) | `NOT_EVIDENCED_AT_TIPS` | `NOT_EVIDENCED_LOCALLY` | `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY`.
44	- **Q2 records** → by **type** only: `CONFIG_RULE` (K-CI, K-HOOK, K-CODEOWNERS, K-LOCALHOOK), `STATUS/NORM_RECORD` (K-STATUS), `STATE_RECORD_BY_TYPE` (K-DEPLOY), `IDENTITY_ATTESTATION` (K-SIG); content not read.
45	- **Q3 controls** → `CONTROLLED_BY_WRITERS[n=…]` (count only) | for `K-SIG` `ND(keyring not consulted)` | `LOCAL_MACHINE` (`K-LOCALHOOK`).
46	- **Q4 timestamps independent** → `NO_CLIENT_SET` (git recording times are client-generated; a self-attested timestamp is **not** independence). Content timestamps = `ND`.
47	- **Q5 norm-in-force at t** → `ND` for **every** channel: no channel's content is read, and existence never decides this. (`NO_BY_TYPE` removed.)
48	- **Q6 completeness** → `ND[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]`. **Q6 has a single outcome by design**: the check is existence-only over the tip set, so completeness vs the host can never be shown.
49	- **Q7 independence** → see §3. Reachable: `INDEPENDENT_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL[aliases_unresolved]`, `IND[…]`, `NOT_INDEPENDENT[…]`, `SELF_ATTESTED[…]`, `NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)`, `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY`.
50	- **Q8 reproducible** → `YES_LOCAL` (content-addressed, rerunnable on the same tip set) | `NO_LOCAL_ONLY` (`K-LOCALHOOK`, unversioned) | `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY`.
51	
52	## 3. Independence rule (count overlap only)
53	
54	All sets use the **author** e-mail `%ae` only (never `%ce`), lower-cased, over non-merge commits
55	reachable from the one tip set. Identities never leave a private temp dir; only counts do.
56	
57	- **W_c** = authors of commits touching candidate c's own paths.
58	- **E** (executors) = authors of commits touching the **CODE / TEST roots of Protocol A r1**:
59	  `app/ routes/ database/ resources/ config/ bootstrap/ lang/ public/ tests/`. Root pathspecs are
60	  used, so historic, renamed and deleted paths under those roots count. **Excluded** (as
61	  `:(exclude,glob,icase)` pathspecs): every candidate-channel **glob pattern** of §1 (a glob
62	  translation of the classifier, not the tip path names) and `docs/knowledgeos/**`. Doc and
63	  governance roots (`docs/`, `developer_guide/`, `engineering/`, `.claude/`, `claude/`,
64	  `scripts/`, `storage/`, READMEs) are **not** executor paths.
65	- **Norm-register paths** = K-STATUS paths matching `ruling(s)|register|registry|decision(s)|norm|inforce|authoriz`.
66	- **N_c** = authors of commits touching the norm-register paths **minus c's own paths**. N is
67	  never derived from the candidate's own paths.
68	- `overlap_exec = |W_c ∩ E|`, `overlap_norm = |W_c ∩ N_c|` (`NA` when N_c's path set is empty).
69	
70	Mapping, applied in this order:
71	1. `K-STATUS` **is** the norm register / in-force record channel → `SELF_ATTESTED[norm_register;overlap_exec=…;overlap_norm=…]`.
72	   A self-attested record; **not** a construction-forced `NOT_INDEPENDENT`.
73	2. N_c's path set is empty → `IND[no_norm_source_distinct_from_candidate;…]`.
74	3. Mechanism **unobservable locally** (`K-CI`, `K-HOOK`, `K-CODEOWNERS`: enforcement is host/client-side;
75	   `K-SIG`: signatures unverified; `K-LOCALHOOK`: local, unversioned) → `IND` with the overlap counts where computed.
76	4. Mechanism observable (`K-DEPLOY`: writer set in repo) and any of W_c, N_c, E empty → `IND[empty_set;W=…;N_c=…;E=…]`.
77	5. Observable, `overlap_norm>0` → `NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_norm]`; else `overlap_exec>0` → `NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_exec]`
78	   (an **observed** cross-role authorship).
79	6. Observable, W_c ≠ ∅, N_c ≠ ∅, E ≠ ∅ and both overlaps `0` →
80	   **`INDEPENDENT_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL[aliases_unresolved]`** (qualified positive: no shared author
81	   identity is observed; it does not show who controls the channel on the host).
82	
83	**Disclosed limits of §3:** identity aliases (one person, several e-mails) are **not** resolved, so
84	overlaps may be undercounted and the positive is qualified accordingly; a rename commit spanning a
85	code root and a channel path is still counted in E (and in W_c).
86	
87	## 4. Completeness rule
88	
89	**Checkable locally:** existence of the paths/hooks above in the tip set; per-channel commit count,
90	writer **count** and signature **presence**; writer-overlap counts. **Not checkable locally
91	(declared):** branch-protection enforcement, PR approvals, server audit logs, CI run history, org
92	membership, host push times, and whether the local ref set is complete vs the host. All of these
93	are `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY` / `COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN`; the content of any file (what a rule
94	or record *says*) is `ND` because content is not read.
95	
96	## 5. Output (written by `scope_b.sh` into an empty `$OUT` outside the repo)
97	
98	- `60_channel_metrics.tsv` — per channel: `channel, paths, commits, writers, overlap_exec, overlap_norm, norm_paths_c, norm_writers_c` (counts only).
99	- `61_path_ids.tsv` — `16-hex-id → channel` (no path strings leave the repo).
100	- `58_signatures.tsv` — `commits_total, commits_signed, tags_signed`.
101	- `56_local_hooks.tsv` — `standard_hooks_present, core_hooksPath`.
102	- `70_answers.tsv` — candidate × Q1..Q8 (the §2/§3 mapping), incl. `K-SIG`, `K-LOCALHOOK`, host rows.
103	- `71_overall.tsv` — `headline` **computed from the per-channel Q7 values** (local rows), first match wins:
104	  - `LOCAL_INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATE_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL` — ≥1 Q7 = `INDEPENDENT_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL…`;
105	  - `LOCAL_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE` — else ≥1 Q7 = `IND…`;
106	  - `LOCAL_NO_INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATE_OBSERVED` — else ≥1 Q7 = `NOT_INDEPENDENT…` / `SELF_ATTESTED…`;
107	  - `LOCAL_NO_CANDIDATE_EVIDENCED` — else (all local rows `NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)`).
108	
109	  The headline covers local channels only; host channels stay `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY`. Also:
110	  `complete_vs_host=NOT_SHOWN`, per-outcome Q7 counts, `not_evidenced`, `host_channels`, `identity_guard`.
111	- `00_script.sha256`, `00_env.tsv` (incl. `repo_local_config=READABLE`), `00_errors.tsv`, and `SHA256SUMS` over every emitted file.
112	
113	**Guarantees:** read-only; `LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC`; config isolation (N4): system/global config off,
114	`GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS` / `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT` unset, and every git call gets `-c log.follow=false
115	-c diff.renames=false -c log.decorate=false -c core.fsmonitor=false -c log.showSignature=false`
116	(plus `core.quotepath=off`, `log.mailmap=false`, `color.ui=never`); **the repo-local config stays
117	readable** (declared). No `set -e` (explicit exits 0/1/2/3); own absolute path resolved+hashed
118	**before** the one `cd`; refuses any `$OUT` inside the work tree or `.git`; emits **counts only** —
119	no names, emails, ref names, URLs, owners or path strings. A final `identity_guard` greps `$OUT` for
120	`@`/signature markers and fails **closed**: a hit → `FAIL`, any grep error (rc ≥ 2) → `FAIL(grep_rc)`,
121	both exit 1. The **only** content read beyond existence/size/counts is commit/tag object headers for
122	**signature presence** (Q1/Q2/Q7 for `K-SIG` strictly require it); no file blob is read.
123	
124	## 6. Disclosed limitations (not fixed in r1)
125	
126	- **N7:** `cat-file` errors in the signature loops are not checked (failures count as unsigned); tags are counted per ref, not per object; x509 `SIGNED MESSAGE` tag signatures are missed.
127	- **N8:** in a linked worktree, OUT is checked against the per-worktree gitdir only, not `git rev-parse --git-common-dir`.
128	- **N10:** path IDs are unsalted SHA-256 prefixes, so predictable paths can be reversed by dictionary (no identity leak).
129	- **N11:** `$TMP` holds plaintext e-mails (removed on EXIT, not on SIGKILL); `mkdir -p` may create missing parents of OUT.
130	- **N13:** remaining protocol/script mismatches: Q4 omits the content-timestamp qualifier in the output; K-SIG carries no overlap counts; K-LOCALHOOK Q4 = `NONE`; Q8 shows reproducibility, not independent verification; token `authoriz` is reachable only with another K-STATUS token; script length.
131	- **N15:** only top-level `docs/knowledgeos/` is excluded as self-contamination; whether `.claude/` / `claude/` hold programme artefacts is not checked.
132

   `K-SIG`: signatures unverified; `K-LOCALHOOK`: local, unversioned) → `IND` with the overlap counts where computed.
4. Mechanism observable (`K-DEPLOY`: writer set in repo) and any of W_c, N_c, E empty → `IND[empty_set;W=…;N_c=…;E=…]`.
5. Observable, `overlap_norm>0` → `NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_norm]`; else `overlap_exec>0` → `NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_exec]`
   (an **observed** cross-role authorship).
6. Observable, W_c ≠ ∅, N_c ≠ ∅, E ≠ ∅ and both overlaps `0` →
   **`INDEPENDENT_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL[aliases_unresolved]`** (qualified positive: no shared author
   identity is observed; it does not show who controls the channel on the host).

**Disclosed limits of §3:** identity aliases (one person, several e-mails) are **not** resolved, so
overlaps may be undercounted and the positive is qualified accordingly; a rename commit spanning a
code root and a channel path is still counted in E (and in W_c).

## 4. Completeness rule

**Checkable locally:** existence of the paths/hooks above in the tip set; per-channel commit count,
writer **count** and signature **presence**; writer-overlap counts. **Not checkable locally
(declared):** branch-protection enforcement, PR approvals, server audit logs, CI run history, org
membership, host push times, and whether the local ref set is complete vs the host. All of these
are `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY` / `COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN`; the content of any file (what a rule
or record *says*) is `ND` because content is not read.

## 5. Output (written by `scope_b.sh` into an empty `$OUT` outside the repo)

- `60_channel_metrics.tsv` — per channel: `channel, paths, commits, writers, overlap_exec, overlap_norm, norm_paths_c, norm_writers_c` (counts only).
- `61_path_ids.tsv` — `16-hex-id → channel` (no path strings leave the repo).
- `58_signatures.tsv` — `commits_total, commits_signed, tags_signed`.
- `56_local_hooks.tsv` — `standard_hooks_present, core_hooksPath`.
- `70_answers.tsv` — candidate × Q1..Q8 (the §2/§3 mapping), incl. `K-SIG`, `K-LOCALHOOK`, host rows.
- `71_overall.tsv` — `headline` **computed from the per-channel Q7 values** (local rows), first match wins:
  - `LOCAL_INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATE_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL` — ≥1 Q7 = `INDEPENDENT_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL…`;
  - `LOCAL_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE` — else ≥1 Q7 = `IND…`;
  - `LOCAL_NO_INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATE_OBSERVED` — else ≥1 Q7 = `NOT_INDEPENDENT…` / `SELF_ATTESTED…`;
  - `LOCAL_NO_CANDIDATE_EVIDENCED` — else (all local rows `NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)`).

  The headline covers local channels only; host channels stay `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY`. Also:
  `complete_vs_host=NOT_SHOWN`, per-outcome Q7 counts, `not_evidenced`, `host_channels`, `identity_guard`.
- `00_script.sha256`, `00_env.tsv` (incl. `repo_local_config=READABLE`), `00_errors.tsv`, and `SHA256SUMS` over every emitted file.

**Guarantees:** read-only; `LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC`; config isolation (N4): system/global config off,
`GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS` / `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT` unset, and every git call gets `-c log.follow=false
-c diff.renames=false -c log.decorate=false -c core.fsmonitor=false -c log.showSignature=false`
(plus `core.quotepath=off`, `log.mailmap=false`, `color.ui=never`); **the repo-local config stays
readable** (declared). No `set -e` (explicit exits 0/1/2/3); own absolute path resolved+hashed
**before** the one `cd`; refuses any `$OUT` inside the work tree or `.git`; emits **counts only** —
no names, emails, ref names, URLs, owners or path strings. A final `identity_guard` greps `$OUT` for
`@`/signature markers and fails **closed**: a hit → `FAIL`, any grep error (rc ≥ 2) → `FAIL(grep_rc)`,
both exit 1. The **only** content read beyond existence/size/counts is commit/tag object headers for
**signature presence** (Q1/Q2/Q7 for `K-SIG` strictly require it); no file blob is read.

## 6. Disclosed limitations (not fixed in r1)

- **N7:** `cat-file` errors in the signature loops are not checked (failures count as unsigned); tags are counted per ref, not per object; x509 `SIGNED MESSAGE` tag signatures are missed.
- **N8:** in a linked worktree, OUT is checked against the per-worktree gitdir only, not `git rev-parse --git-common-dir`.
- **N10:** path IDs are unsalted SHA-256 prefixes, so predictable paths can be reversed by dictionary (no identity leak).
- **N11:** `$TMP` holds plaintext e-mails (removed on EXIT, not on SIGKILL); `mkdir -p` may create missing parents of OUT.
- **N13:** remaining protocol/script mismatches: Q4 omits the content-timestamp qualifier in the output; K-SIG carries no overlap counts; K-LOCALHOOK Q4 = `NONE`; Q8 shows reproducibility, not independent verification; token `authoriz` is reachable only with another K-STATUS token; script length.
- **N15:** only top-level `docs/knowledgeos/` is excluded as self-contamination; whether `.claude/` / `claude/` hold programme artefacts is not checked.

164	  "$HL" "$nI" "$nD" "$nX" "$nA" "$nNE" > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"

168	elif [ "$g" -eq 0 ]; then printf 'identity_guard\tFAIL(%s files)\n' "$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/hit")" >> "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; code=1

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scope_b.sh (r1) -- Protocol B scoping. Read-only; existence/metadata only. No network, no host access.
# Emits COUNTS ONLY: no names, emails, ref names, URLs or path strings leave TMP; paths -> 16-hex ids.
# The ONLY content read beyond existence/counts is commit/tag object headers for signature PRESENCE
# (Q1/Q2/Q7 for K-SIG strictly require it); no file blob is ever read.
# Usage (from anywhere inside the working clone):  OUT=/abs/empty/dir bash scope_b.sh
# Exit: 0 ok | 1 ok-with-unexpected-codes or identity-guard fail | 2 refused | 3 capture invalid
set -u -o pipefail
export LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null \
  GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1
unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES GIT_NAMESPACE \
  GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS GIT_CONFIG_COUNT   # N4: no injected config; repo-local config stays readable (declared)
die() { printf 'scope_b: %s\n' "$2" >&2; exit "$1"; }

# ---- resolve OWN absolute path and hash it BEFORE any cd (corrects earlier relative-BASH_SOURCE defect) ----
SELF="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"; case "$SELF" in /*) ;; *) SELF="$PWD/$SELF" ;; esac
SELF="$(realpath -- "$SELF")" || die 2 "cannot resolve own path"
SELFSHA="$(sha256sum < "$SELF" | cut -d' ' -f1)" || die 2 "cannot hash self"
# N4: these overrides are passed to EVERY git call
git() { command git -c core.quotepath=off -c log.mailmap=false -c color.ui=never -c log.follow=false -c diff.renames=false \
  -c log.decorate=false -c core.fsmonitor=false -c log.showSignature=false "$@"; }

# ---- preconditions (exit 2) ----
OUT="${OUT:-}"; [ -n "$OUT" ] || die 2 "OUT not set"
case "$OUT" in /*) ;; *) die 2 "OUT must be an absolute path" ;; esac
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null)" = true ] || die 2 "not inside a work tree"
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-bare-repository 2>/dev/null)" = false ] || die 2 "bare repository"
TOP="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || die 2 "no toplevel"
GD="$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir)" || die 2 "no git dir"
OUT="$(realpath -m -- "$OUT")" || die 2 "realpath OUT failed"
TOPR="$(realpath -- "$TOP")"; GDR="$(realpath -- "$GD")"
for d in "$TOPR" "$GDR"; do case "$OUT/" in "$d"/*) die 2 "OUT must be outside the work tree and .git" ;; esac; done
if [ -e "$OUT" ]; then { [ -d "$OUT" ] && [ -z "$(ls -A -- "$OUT")" ]; } || die 2 "OUT must be an empty directory"; fi
TMP="$(mktemp -d)" || die 2 "mktemp failed"; TMP="$(realpath -- "$TMP")"
case "$TMP/" in "$TOPR"/*|"$GDR"/*|"$OUT"/*) rm -rf -- "$TMP"; die 2 "TMPDIR must be outside the repo and OUT" ;; esac
trap 'rm -rf -- "$TMP"' EXIT
mkdir -p -- "$OUT" || die 2 "cannot create OUT"
cd -- "$TOP" || die 2 "cannot cd to the toplevel"   # the one and only cd; self already resolved+hashed above

ERR="$OUT/00_errors.tsv"; : > "$ERR"; : > "$TMP/e"
ok() { local l="$1" rc="$2" a; shift 2; for a in "$@"; do [ "$rc" = "$a" ] && return 0; done; printf '%s\t%s\n' "$l" "$rc" >> "$ERR"; return 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$SELFSHA" > "$OUT/00_script.sha256"
printf 'git_version\t%s\nrepo_local_config\tREADABLE(not isolated; declared)\n' "$(git --version)" > "$OUT/00_env.tsv"
ND=NOT_DETERMINABLE_BY_EXISTENCE_CHECK; IND=INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE
finish() { ( cd -- "$OUT" && find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print | sort | xargs -r -d '\n' sha256sum ) > "$OUT/SHA256SUMS"; exit "$1"; }

# ---- capture validity + THE ONE tip set (B1/N5/N12) -> tracked path universe at tips ----
SH="$(git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository 2>/dev/null)"; ok env.shallow $? 0
PC="$(git config --get extensions.partialClone)"; ok cfg.partialClone $? 0 1
if [ "$SH" != false ] || [ -n "$PC" ]; then printf 'overall\tCAPTURE_INVALID\n' > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; finish 3; fi
# tip set = refs/heads/**, refs/remotes/**, refs/tags/** only (never refs/stash, refs/notes/**); tags peeled; commit-type only
git for-each-ref --format='%(objectname) %(objecttype)' refs/heads refs/remotes refs/tags > "$TMP/refs" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok refs $? 0
: > "$TMP/t0"
while read -r o ty; do case "$ty" in commit) printf '%s\n' "$o" >> "$TMP/t0" ;;
  tag) git rev-parse --verify -q "$o^{commit}" < /dev/null >> "$TMP/t0" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok peel $? 0 1 ;; esac; done < "$TMP/refs"
sort -u "$TMP/t0" > "$TMP/tips"
[ -s "$TMP/tips" ] || { printf 'overall\tCAPTURE_INVALID\n' > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; finish 3; }
: > "$TMP/paths"   # N9: read with -z; an embedded newline is carried as \001 and restored before any pathspec/hash use
while IFS= read -r t; do git ls-tree -r -z --name-only --full-tree "$t" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | tr '\n\0' '\001\n' >> "$TMP/paths"
  ok lstree "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0; done < "$TMP/tips"
sort -u "$TMP/paths" > "$TMP/pu"; mv "$TMP/pu" "$TMP/paths"

# ---- classify candidate channels (bounded vocabulary; docs/knowledgeos excluded) ----
awk -F'\t' '
{ p=$0; q=tolower(p); b=q; sub(/.*\//,"",b)
  if (q ~ /^docs\/knowledgeos\//) next
  if (q ~ /^[.]github\/workflows\// || q==".gitlab-ci.yml" || b=="jenkinsfile" || q ~ /^[.]circleci\// || q=="azure-pipelines.yml" || q==".drone.yml" || q=="bitbucket-pipelines.yml" || q ~ /^[.]woodpecker/) print "K-CI\t" p
  if (q ~ /^[.]githooks\// || q ~ /^[.]husky\// || q==".pre-commit-config.yaml" || b=="lefthook.yml" || b==".lefthook.yml") print "K-HOOK\t" p
  if (b=="codeowners") print "K-CODEOWNERS\t" p
  e=""; if (b ~ /[.][^.]+$/){e=b; sub(/.*[.]/,"",e)}
  docx=(e=="md"||e=="markdown"||e=="txt"||e=="rst"||e=="json"||e=="yaml"||e=="yml"||e=="toml"||e=="csv"||e=="tsv")
  if (docx && q ~ /(^|\/)(program_status|status|rulings?|register|registry|decisions?|adoptions?|approvals?|signoffs?|progress|inforce|norm)([._/-]|$)/) print "K-STATUS\t" p
  if (q ~ /(^|\/)(deploy|deployment|release|environment|env|infra|terraform)([._/-]|$)/ || e=="tfstate") print "K-DEPLOY\t" p }' \
  "$TMP/paths" | sort -u > "$TMP/cand"

# ---- B3/B4: executor set E = AUTHOR e-mails (%ae only) of non-merge commits touching the Protocol-A r1 CODE/TEST
# ROOTS over the full history of the tip set; every candidate-channel GLOB pattern and docs/knowledgeos/** excluded.
ROOTS=( app routes database resources config bootstrap lang public tests )
CHG=( '.github/workflows/**' '.gitlab-ci.yml' '**/jenkinsfile' '.circleci/**' 'azure-pipelines.yml' '.drone.yml' 'bitbucket-pipelines.yml'
  '.woodpecker*' '.woodpecker*/**' '.githooks/**' '.husky/**' '.pre-commit-config.yaml' '**/lefthook.yml' '**/.lefthook.yml' '**/codeowners' '**/*.tfstate' )
for t in program_status status ruling rulings register registry decision decisions adoption adoptions approval approvals signoff signoffs progress inforce norm; do
  for x in md markdown txt rst json yaml yml toml csv tsv; do CHG+=( "**/$t.$x" "**/$t[._-]*.$x" "**/$t/**/*.$x" "**/$t[._-]*/**/*.$x" ); done; done
for t in deploy deployment release environment env infra terraform; do CHG+=( "**/$t" "**/$t/**" "**/$t[._-]*" "**/$t[._-]*/**" ); done
PS=( ); for r in "${ROOTS[@]}"; do PS+=( ":(literal)$r" ); done
PS+=( ':(exclude,glob,icase)docs/knowledgeos/**' ); for g in "${CHG[@]}"; do PS+=( ":(exclude,glob,icase)$g" ); done
git log --stdin --no-merges --format='%ae' -- "${PS[@]}" < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/E"
ok writers.exec "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0; nE=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/E")
# B2: norm-register paths (K-STATUS rulings/register subset); N_c = their authors MINUS candidate c's own paths
awk -F'\t' '$1=="K-STATUS"{p=$0; sub(/^[^\t]*\t/,"",p); if (tolower(p) ~ /(^|\/)(rulings?|register|registry|decisions?|norm|inforce|authoriz)/) print p}' \
  "$TMP/cand" | sort -u > "$TMP/npaths"

# ---- per-channel metrics (counts only; W, commits, N_c all via --stdin over the one tip set) + path-id map ----
: > "$OUT/61_path_ids.tsv"; : > "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"
for ch in K-CI K-HOOK K-CODEOWNERS K-STATUS K-DEPLOY; do
  awk -v c="$ch" 'index($0, c "\t")==1{print substr($0, length(c)+2)}' "$TMP/cand" | sort -u > "$TMP/cp"
  np=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/cp"); : > "$TMP/W"; nc=0
  while IFS= read -r p; do pr="${p//$'\001'/$'\n'}"
    id="$(printf '%s' "$pr" | sha256sum | cut -c1-16)"; printf '%s\t%s\n' "$id" "$ch" >> "$OUT/61_path_ids.tsv"
    git log --stdin --no-merges --format='%ae' -- ":(literal)$pr" < "$TMP/tips" > "$TMP/w1" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok "w.$id" $? 0
    nc=$((nc + $(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/w1"))); cat "$TMP/w1" >> "$TMP/W"
  done < "$TMP/cp"
  tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' < "$TMP/W" | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/Wu"
  comm -23 "$TMP/npaths" "$TMP/cp" > "$TMP/ncp"; nnp=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/ncp"); : > "$TMP/Nc"
  if [ -s "$TMP/ncp" ]; then NPS=( ); while IFS= read -r p; do NPS+=( ":(literal)${p//$'\001'/$'\n'}" ); done < "$TMP/ncp"
    git log --stdin --no-merges --format='%ae' -- "${NPS[@]}" < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/Nc"
    ok "writers.norm.$ch" "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0; fi
  nw=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/Wu"); nn=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/Nc")
  oe=$(comm -12 "$TMP/Wu" "$TMP/E" | awk 'END{print NR}'); on=$(comm -12 "$TMP/Wu" "$TMP/Nc" | awk 'END{print NR}')
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$ch" "$np" "$nc" "$nw" "$oe" "$on" "$nnp" "$nn" >> "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"
done

# ---- K-SIG: signature PRESENCE only (justified object-header read; keyring not consulted) ----
git rev-list --stdin < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | sort -u > "$TMP/allc"; ok revlist "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0
nS=0; while IFS= read -r c; do
  git cat-file commit "$c" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | awk '/^$/{exit} /^gpgsig/{s=1} END{exit (s?0:1)}' && nS=$((nS+1)); done < "$TMP/allc"
nTS=0; while IFS= read -r line; do set -- $line; [ "${2:-}" = tag ] || continue
  git cat-file tag "$1" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | grep -qE '^-----BEGIN (PGP|SSH) SIGNATURE-----$' && nTS=$((nTS+1)); done < "$TMP/refs"
printf 'commits_total\t%s\ncommits_signed\t%s\ntags_signed\t%s\n' "$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/allc")" "$nS" "$nTS" > "$OUT/58_signatures.tsv"

# ---- K-LOCALHOOK: local .git/hooks presence (LOCAL_ONLY, unversioned) ----
HOOKS="applypatch-msg commit-msg post-checkout post-commit post-merge post-receive post-update pre-applypatch pre-commit pre-merge-commit pre-push pre-rebase pre-receive prepare-commit-msg update"
nh=0; for hk in $HOOKS; do [ -e "$GD/hooks/$hk" ] && nh=$((nh+1)); done
hp=unset; git config --get core.hooksPath > /dev/null 2>&1 && hp=set
printf 'standard_hooks_present\t%s\ncore_hooksPath\t%s\n' "$nh" "$hp" > "$OUT/56_local_hooks.tsv"

# ---- answers Q1..Q8 (deterministic; every outcome reachable; never a forced negative) ----
NA7='NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)'
{
printf '#channel\tQ1_exists\tQ2_records\tQ3_controls\tQ4_ts_independent\tQ5_norm_at_t\tQ6_complete\tQ7_independent\tQ8_reproducible\n'
awk -F'\t' -v ND="$ND" -v IND="$IND" -v nE="$nE" 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"; na="NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)"}
{ ch=$1; np=$2+0; nw=$4+0; oe=$5+0; on=$6+0; nnp=$7+0; nn=$8+0
  if (np==0){ print ch,"NOT_EVIDENCED_AT_TIPS",na,na,na,na,na,na,na; next }
  cfg=(ch=="K-CI"||ch=="K-HOOK"||ch=="K-CODEOWNERS")
  q2=cfg?"CONFIG_RULE(by type; content not read)":(ch=="K-STATUS"?"STATUS/NORM_RECORD(by type; content not read)":"STATE_RECORD_BY_TYPE(content not read)")
  ov="overlap_exec=" oe ";overlap_norm=" (nnp>0 ? on : "NA")
  if (ch=="K-STATUS") q7="SELF_ATTESTED[norm_register;" ov "]"
  else if (nnp==0) q7=IND "[no_norm_source_distinct_from_candidate;" ov "]"
  else if (cfg) q7=IND "[mechanism_host_enforced_unobservable;" ov "]"
  else if (nw==0 || nn==0 || nE==0) q7=IND "[empty_set;W=" nw ";N_c=" nn ";E=" nE "]"
  else if (on>0) q7="NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_norm=" on "]"
  else if (oe>0) q7="NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_exec=" oe "]"
  else q7="INDEPENDENT_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL[aliases_unresolved]"
  print ch,"YES_IN_CAPTURE",q2,"CONTROLLED_BY_WRITERS[n=" nw "]","NO_CLIENT_SET(git recording times are client-generated)",ND,ND "[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]",q7,"YES_LOCAL(content-addressed; rerunnable on same ref set)" }' \
  "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"
read -r nC nSg nTg < <(awk -F'\t' '{v[$1]=$2} END{print v["commits_total"]+0, v["commits_signed"]+0, v["tags_signed"]+0}' "$OUT/58_signatures.tsv")
if [ "$nSg" -gt 0 ] || [ "$nTg" -gt 0 ]; then
  printf 'K-SIG\tYES_IN_CAPTURE\tIDENTITY_ATTESTATION(presence only; not verified)\t%s(keyring not consulted)\tNO_CLIENT_SET(signer clock)\t%s\t%s[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]\t%s(signatures not verified)\tYES_LOCAL(presence only)\n' "$ND" "$ND" "$ND" "$IND"
else printf "K-SIG\tNOT_EVIDENCED_AT_TIPS\t$NA7\n"; fi
read -r hn hpv < <(awk -F'\t' '{v[$1]=$2} END{print v["standard_hooks_present"]+0, v["core_hooksPath"]}' "$OUT/56_local_hooks.tsv")
if [ "$hn" -gt 0 ] || [ "$hpv" = set ]; then
  printf 'K-LOCALHOOK\tYES_LOCAL_ONLY\tCONFIG_RULE(by type; content not read)\tLOCAL_MACHINE\tNONE\t%s\t%s[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]\t%s(local, unversioned)\tNO_LOCAL_ONLY(not versioned; not reproducible from the ref set)\n' "$ND" "$ND" "$IND"
else printf "K-LOCALHOOK\tNOT_EVIDENCED_LOCALLY\t$NA7\n"; fi
for hc in K-HOST-AUDIT K-HOST-BRANCHPROT K-HOST-PR-APPROVALS K-CI-RUNS K-HOST-MEMBERS; do
  printf '%s\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\n' "$hc"; done
} > "$OUT/70_answers.tsv"

# ---- overall: headline COMPUTED from the per-channel Q7 values (N2/N14) + fail-closed identity guard (N6) ----
q7n() { awk -F'\t' -v r="$1" 'NR>1 && $8 ~ r {c++} END{print c+0}' "$OUT/70_answers.tsv"; }
nI=$(q7n '^INDEPENDENT_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL'); nD=$(q7n '^INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE'); nX=$(q7n '^NOT_INDEPENDENT'); nA=$(q7n '^SELF_ATTESTED')
if [ "$nI" -gt 0 ]; then HL=LOCAL_INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATE_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL; elif [ "$nD" -gt 0 ]; then HL=LOCAL_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE
elif [ $((nX+nA)) -gt 0 ]; then HL=LOCAL_NO_INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATE_OBSERVED; else HL=LOCAL_NO_CANDIDATE_EVIDENCED; fi
nNE=$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1 && $2 ~ /^NOT_EVIDENCED/{c++} END{print c+0}' "$OUT/70_answers.tsv")
printf 'headline\t%s\ncomplete_vs_host\tNOT_SHOWN\nindependent_at_identity_count_level\t%s\nopen_local_candidates\t%s\nnot_independent_by_overlap\t%s\nself_attested\t%s\nnot_evidenced\t%s\nhost_channels\t5\n' \
  "$HL" "$nI" "$nD" "$nX" "$nA" "$nNE" > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"
code=0; [ -s "$ERR" ] && code=1
grep -rlE '@|BEGIN (PGP|SSH) SIGNATURE' -- "$OUT" > "$TMP/hit" 2>/dev/null; g=$?
if [ "$g" -eq 1 ]; then printf 'identity_guard\tPASS\n' >> "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"
elif [ "$g" -eq 0 ]; then printf 'identity_guard\tFAIL(%s files)\n' "$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/hit")" >> "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; code=1
else printf 'identity_guard\tFAIL(grep_rc=%s)\n' "$g" >> "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; code=1; fi
finish "$code"

1	# CHANGELOG — Protocol B r0 → r1 (targeted repair of REVIEW-r0 FAIL)
2	
3	Only the defects listed in TASK.md were changed. Nothing was executed.
4	
5	## Blocking
6	
7	- **B1 — one tip set for every history query.** The per-path W and commit-count queries (r0 l.91–92, HEAD only) now use `git log --stdin < tips`, the same as E, N_c and `rev-list`. The commit count comes from the same call as W (one `%ae` line per non-merge commit). Output no longer depends on the checked-out HEAD. *(scope_b.sh: tip block, per-channel loop; PROTOCOL-B §1 "The one tip set")*
8	- **B2 — N never derived from the candidate's own paths.** The global N was replaced by a per-candidate **N_c** = authors over the norm-register paths **minus c's own paths** (`comm -23 npaths cp`). If N_c's path set is empty → `IND[no_norm_source_distinct_from_candidate]`. K-STATUS (the norm register / in-force record channel) → `SELF_ATTESTED[norm_register;overlap_exec=…;overlap_norm=…]`. `NORM_SOURCE_NOT_INDEPENDENT` was removed. New metrics columns: `norm_paths_c`, `norm_writers_c`. *(§3; answers awk)*
9	- **B3 — E defined by repository ROOT over full history.** E now uses the Protocol A r1 CODE/TEST root pathspecs (`app routes database resources config bootstrap lang public tests`), so historic, renamed and deleted paths are covered. The exclusions are the candidate-channel **glob patterns** (a `:(exclude,glob,icase)` translation of the classifier) plus `docs/knowledgeos/**`. The r0 `:(exclude,literal)<tip path>` list was removed.
10	- **B4 — E measures authorship of executor work.** Every set uses `%ae` only (`%ce` dropped from W, E and N). Doc and governance roots are no longer executor paths. Disclosed: identity aliases are not resolved, and a rename commit spanning a code root and a channel path is still counted. *(§3 "Disclosed limits")*
11	- **B5 — K-DEPLOY no longer a config rule.** K-DEPLOY was removed from the `cfg` group. Q2 = `STATE_RECORD_BY_TYPE(content not read)`, Q5 = `ND`. This also removes the r0 dead `ND` branch for Q2.
12	
13	## Non-blocking (fixed)
14	
15	- **N1 — Q5.** `NO_BY_TYPE` was removed everywhere. Q5 = `NOT_DETERMINABLE_BY_EXISTENCE_CHECK` for every channel (K-CI, K-HOOK, K-CODEOWNERS, K-STATUS, K-DEPLOY, K-SIG, K-LOCALHOOK), because no content is read.
16	- **N2 — INDEPENDENT reachable; headline computed.**
17	  - Q7 `INDEPENDENT_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL[aliases_unresolved]` is now reachable. Condition: the mechanism is observable, W_c ≠ ∅, N_c ≠ ∅, E ≠ ∅, `overlap_norm=0` and `overlap_exec=0`.
18	  - Unobservable mechanisms keep `IND`. If any of the sets is empty, the result is `IND[empty_set;…]`.
19	  - The protocol now states that Q6 has a single outcome by design.
20	  - The `71_overall.tsv` headline is computed from the per-channel Q7 values, and per-outcome Q7 counts were added.
21	- **N3 — Q1 negative label.** `NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_CAPTURE` → `NOT_EVIDENCED_AT_TIPS` (path channels and K-SIG).
22	- **N4 — config isolation.**
23	  - `GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS` and `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT` are now unset.
24	  - The `git()` wrapper passes `-c log.follow=false -c diff.renames=false -c log.decorate=false -c core.fsmonitor=false -c log.showSignature=false` to every call.
25	  - The repo-local config remaining readable is disclosed in PROTOCOL-B and in `00_env.tsv`.
26	- **N5 — commit-type tips only.** Tags are peeled with `rev-parse --verify -q <oid>^{commit}`, which handles nested tags and drops tags pointing to trees or blobs. Only commit-type tips are kept.
27	- **N6 — identity guard fails closed.** grep rc 0 → `FAIL(n files)`, rc 1 → `PASS`, rc ≥ 2 → `FAIL(grep_rc=…)`. Both FAIL cases exit 1.

# CHANGELOG — Protocol B r0 → r1 (targeted repair of REVIEW-r0 FAIL)

Only the defects listed in TASK.md were changed. Nothing was executed.

## Blocking

- **B1 — one tip set for every history query.** The per-path W and commit-count queries (r0 l.91–92, HEAD only) now use `git log --stdin < tips`, the same as E, N_c and `rev-list`. The commit count comes from the same call as W (one `%ae` line per non-merge commit). Output no longer depends on the checked-out HEAD. *(scope_b.sh: tip block, per-channel loop; PROTOCOL-B §1 "The one tip set")*
- **B2 — N never derived from the candidate's own paths.** The global N was replaced by a per-candidate **N_c** = authors over the norm-register paths **minus c's own paths** (`comm -23 npaths cp`). If N_c's path set is empty → `IND[no_norm_source_distinct_from_candidate]`. K-STATUS (the norm register / in-force record channel) → `SELF_ATTESTED[norm_register;overlap_exec=…;overlap_norm=…]`. `NORM_SOURCE_NOT_INDEPENDENT` was removed. New metrics columns: `norm_paths_c`, `norm_writers_c`. *(§3; answers awk)*
- **B3 — E defined by repository ROOT over full history.** E now uses the Protocol A r1 CODE/TEST root pathspecs (`app routes database resources config bootstrap lang public tests`), so historic, renamed and deleted paths are covered. The exclusions are the candidate-channel **glob patterns** (a `:(exclude,glob,icase)` translation of the classifier) plus `docs/knowledgeos/**`. The r0 `:(exclude,literal)<tip path>` list was removed.
- **B4 — E measures authorship of executor work.** Every set uses `%ae` only (`%ce` dropped from W, E and N). Doc and governance roots are no longer executor paths. Disclosed: identity aliases are not resolved, and a rename commit spanning a code root and a channel path is still counted. *(§3 "Disclosed limits")*
- **B5 — K-DEPLOY no longer a config rule.** K-DEPLOY was removed from the `cfg` group. Q2 = `STATE_RECORD_BY_TYPE(content not read)`, Q5 = `ND`. This also removes the r0 dead `ND` branch for Q2.

## Non-blocking (fixed)

- **N1 — Q5.** `NO_BY_TYPE` was removed everywhere. Q5 = `NOT_DETERMINABLE_BY_EXISTENCE_CHECK` for every channel (K-CI, K-HOOK, K-CODEOWNERS, K-STATUS, K-DEPLOY, K-SIG, K-LOCALHOOK), because no content is read.
- **N2 — INDEPENDENT reachable; headline computed.**
  - Q7 `INDEPENDENT_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL[aliases_unresolved]` is now reachable. Condition: the mechanism is observable, W_c ≠ ∅, N_c ≠ ∅, E ≠ ∅, `overlap_norm=0` and `overlap_exec=0`.
  - Unobservable mechanisms keep `IND`. If any of the sets is empty, the result is `IND[empty_set;…]`.
  - The protocol now states that Q6 has a single outcome by design.
  - The `71_overall.tsv` headline is computed from the per-channel Q7 values, and per-outcome Q7 counts were added.
- **N3 — Q1 negative label.** `NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_CAPTURE` → `NOT_EVIDENCED_AT_TIPS` (path channels and K-SIG).
- **N4 — config isolation.**
  - `GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS` and `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT` are now unset.
  - The `git()` wrapper passes `-c log.follow=false -c diff.renames=false -c log.decorate=false -c core.fsmonitor=false -c log.showSignature=false` to every call.
  - The repo-local config remaining readable is disclosed in PROTOCOL-B and in `00_env.tsv`.
- **N5 — commit-type tips only.** Tags are peeled with `rev-parse --verify -q <oid>^{commit}`, which handles nested tags and drops tags pointing to trees or blobs. Only commit-type tips are kept.
- **N6 — identity guard fails closed.** grep rc 0 → `FAIL(n files)`, rc 1 → `PASS`, rc ≥ 2 → `FAIL(grep_rc=…)`. Both FAIL cases exit 1.
- **N9 — `ls-tree -r -z`.** Paths are read NUL-delimited. An embedded newline is carried internally as `\001` and restored before any pathspec or hash use. Tab-safe channel/path splitting replaces `cut -f2` / `$2`.
- **N12 — ref scope.** `for-each-ref` is limited to `refs/heads`, `refs/remotes` and `refs/tags`, so `refs/stash` and `refs/notes/**` are excluded.
- **N14 — headline token.** `NIF_A_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE_BY_EXISTENCE_CHECK` was replaced by four tokens defined in PROTOCOL-B §5: `LOCAL_INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATE_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL`, `LOCAL_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE`, `LOCAL_NO_INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATE_OBSERVED` and `LOCAL_NO_CANDIDATE_EVIDENCED`.

## Non-blocking (left as disclosed limitations, PROTOCOL-B §6)

- **N7, N8, N10, N11, N13, N15.** Each is listed in one line and not fixed. From N13, the "dead Q2 ND branch" item no longer applies after B5.

## Unchanged (by requirement)

- The script is read-only and writes no identities to the output.
- The self path is resolved and hashed before the one `cd`.
- OUT is refused inside the work tree or `.git`.
- No content is read beyond signature-header presence, and no file blob is read.
- The protocol stays neutral.
- The script is ~169 lines (r0: 167).

  `Q1 YES_IN_CAPTURE · Q2 STATUS/NORM_RECORD(by type; content not read) · Q3 CONTROLLED_BY_WRITERS[n=k] · Q4 NO_CLIENT_SET(…) · Q5 ND · Q6 ND[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN] · Q7 SELF_ATTESTED[norm_register;overlap_exec=x;overlap_norm=NA] · Q8 YES_LOCAL(…)`.
  This outcome is **forced**. It is the same whether the file's writers are disjoint from every other set or identical to them. It holds even when the repo has no register path at all, which means the label `norm_register` contradicts the script's own register subset.
- The channel also covers `approval(s)`, `signoff(s)`, `adoption(s)` and `progress`. These are the records most likely to be written by someone other than the norm-maker. Criterion (c), "the ruling asserting its own effect", fits a rulings register. It does not fit a sign-off or status record.
- l.161 puts `SELF_ATTESTED` in the same headline bucket as `NOT_INDEPENDENT` (`LOCAL_NO_INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATE_OBSERVED`). In effect it is a forced negative, which QUESTIONS.md forbids ("never a forced negative"). PROTOCOL §3 rule 1 also contradicts itself when it says this is "not a construction-forced NOT_INDEPENDENT".
- r0 already raised exactly this case (PROGRAM_STATUS.md as a non-register record). r1 made it unconditional: in r0 it applied only when a register path existed.
- *Fix direction:* split K-STATUS into two disjoint channels.
  - `K-NORMREG` = the l.89 subset. `SELF_ATTESTED` is defensible here as a declared definitional outcome, or it can be `IND`.
  - `K-STATUS` = the other status/progress/approval/sign-off records. Send these through rules 2/4/5/6 as an observable channel, with `N_c = K-NORMREG paths − own paths` and `E`.
  - Count `SELF_ATTESTED` separately in the headline, not as an observed negative.

---

## 1. B1: one tip set — **FIXED**
- Tips (l.52–56) come from `for-each-ref refs/heads refs/remotes refs/tags` only. A commit-type ref is kept as is. A tag object is peeled with `rev-parse --verify -q <oid>^{commit}`, which drops tree/blob tags and peels nested tags. The list is `sort -u`'d, and an empty set gives `CAPTURE_INVALID`.
- Every history query reads that one file: path universe `ls-tree` per tip (l.59), E (l.86), W and commit count from the same call (l.99), N_c (l.105), `rev-list` for K-SIG (l.113). Tag signatures use the same filtered `refs` file (l.116).
- No query uses `HEAD`. `--stdin` with a non-empty tip file stops git from defaulting to HEAD. The result does not depend on the checked-out branch. It depends only on the ref set, plus the per-worktree `.git/hooks` (K-LOCALHOOK) and the repo-local config, both declared.

## 2. B2: own paths in N_c — **NOT FIXED (BLK-1)**
- Can a candidate's own paths enter its N_c? **No.** `comm -23 npaths cp` (l.103) removes them by exact tip-path string, and both files are C-sorted. This also fixes the r0 K-DEPLOY case: `release/decisions.md` is in K-DEPLOY's `cp`, so it is removed from K-DEPLOY's N_c.
- PROGRAM_STATUS.md gets Q7 = `SELF_ATTESTED[norm_register;overlap_exec=x;overlap_norm=NA]`. This is **forced by construction**; see BLK-1.

## 3. B3/B4: executor set E — **FIXED**, with disclosed limits
- **Root-based:** yes. `:(literal)app … tests` are directory-prefix pathspecs, so historic, renamed and deleted files under the roots count.
- **Author-only:** yes. `%ae` is used for E, W_c and N_c (l.86, 99, 105). `%ce` is gone, and so is the shared platform-committer artefact.
- **Full-history:** E walks the whole history reachable from every tip, but **without `--full-history`**. git's default history simplification applies. A commit whose change to the pathspec did not survive a merge (TREESAME pruning) is dropped. The same pruning hits W_c and N_c. It can only *lower* overlaps, so it cannot cause a forced negative. It can, though, produce an unqualified `INDEPENDENT…` (NB-1).
- **Can a channel file's historic or renamed versions put its own writers into E?**
  - A historic name that matches the channel vocabulary: **no**. It is excluded by the `:(exclude,glob,icase)` translation (l.79–85), which holds over all history, including deleted paths.
  - I checked the glob translation against the classifier token by token. The token boundary `[._/-]|$`, the doc-ext rule, the `**/` root match, `.woodpecker*` and `*.tfstate` all match the classifier.
  - Remaining leak: a channel file renamed **from a non-vocabulary name inside a code root** (e.g. `config/notes.yml → deploy/notes.yml`). The rename commit's author lands in both E and W_c. This is disclosed (§3 "Disclosed limits"). Earlier editors of the old name did edit a code root, so their E membership counts as observed.
- **Doc/governance roots excluded:** yes. E is an inclusion list of code/test roots, so `docs/`, `developer_guide/`, `engineering/`, `.claude/`, `claude/`, `scripts/` and `storage/` are not in it. `docs/knowledgeos/**` is excluded on top. Residual: READMEs and other markdown *inside* the code roots (e.g. `tests/README.md`) still count as executor work, although §3 says READMEs are not executor paths (NB-4).

## 4. B5/N1: Q5 — **FIXED**
No Q5 = NO is left. Every evidenced row writes `ND`:
- awk column 6 (l.143)
- K-SIG `%s` = `$ND` (l.147)
- K-LOCALHOOK `%s` = `$ND` (l.151)

Otherwise Q5 is `NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)` or `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY`. K-DEPLOY is out of `cfg` and gets Q2 = `STATE_RECORD_BY_TYPE`. The format and argument counts for the K-SIG and K-LOCALHOOK printf lines match (9 columns).

## 5. Reachability

| Q | Reachable outcomes |
|---|---|
| Q1 | `YES_IN_CAPTURE`, `NOT_EVIDENCED_AT_TIPS` (path channels, K-SIG); `YES_LOCAL_ONLY`, `NOT_EVIDENCED_LOCALLY` (K-LOCALHOOK); `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY` (host rows, constant) |
| Q2 | `CONFIG_RULE` (K-CI/HOOK/CODEOWNERS/LOCALHOOK), `STATUS/NORM_RECORD` (K-STATUS), `STATE_RECORD_BY_TYPE` (K-DEPLOY), `IDENTITY_ATTESTATION` (K-SIG): descriptive, one per type; `NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)`; `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY` |
| Q3 | `CONTROLLED_BY_WRITERS[n=k]` (k ≥ 0; `n=0` with paths>0 is reachable through merge-only introduction, empty `%ae` or simplification); `ND(keyring not consulted)` (K-SIG); `LOCAL_MACHINE`; `NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)`; `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY` |
| Q4 | `NO_CLIENT_SET(…)` (all evidenced git-backed rows: a structural fact about client-set git times, not a content claim); `NONE` (K-LOCALHOOK, N13); `NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)`; `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY` |
| Q5 | `ND`; `NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)`; `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY`. Single substantive outcome by design (no content read) |
| Q6 | `ND[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]`; `NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)`; `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY`. Single outcome by design, declared |
| Q7 | K-STATUS: **only** `SELF_ATTESTED[…]` (forced, BLK-1). K-CI/K-HOOK/K-CODEOWNERS: only `IND[no_norm_source…]` or `IND[mechanism_host_enforced_unobservable…]`. K-SIG, K-LOCALHOOK: only `IND`. **K-DEPLOY:** `IND[no_norm_source…]`, `IND[empty_set…]`, `NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_norm=…]`, `NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_exec=…]`, `INDEPENDENT_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL[aliases_unresolved]`. Also `NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)`, `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY` |
| Q8 | `YES_LOCAL(…)`; `NO_LOCAL_ONLY` (K-LOCALHOOK); `NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)`; `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY` |

**Can `INDEPENDENT_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL` be produced? Yes, but only for K-DEPLOY.** A concrete configuration:
- `deploy/production.yml` is authored only by `ops@x`. It is K-DEPLOY via `deploy/` and not K-STATUS.
- `docs/rulings/R-001.md` is authored only by `chair@x`. It is K-STATUS and in `npaths` via `rulings/`, and it is not a K-DEPLOY path.
- `app/Foo.php` is authored only by `dev@x`.

For K-DEPLOY this gives:
- `np=1` and `nnp=1`: `ncp = {docs/rulings/R-001.md}`
- W = {ops}, N_c = {chair}, E = {dev}, so `nw=nn=nE=1`
- `on=oe=0`

Rule 6 then applies, Q7 = `INDEPENDENT_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL[aliases_unresolved]`, and the headline is `LOCAL_INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATE_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL`.

**Is the headline computed from the data? Yes.** `q7n` (l.158–161) counts column 8 of `70_answers.tsv` over the local rows. The anchored patterns are distinct, so `^INDEPENDENT_AT…`, `^INDEPENDENCE_NOT…`, `^NOT_INDEPENDENT` and `^SELF_ATTESTED` never collide with each other or with `NOT_APPLICABLE` or `NOT_CHECKABLE`. First match wins, as §5 says.

**Forced negatives left: one.** K-STATUS `SELF_ATTESTED`, which the headline counts as a negative (BLK-1). No other negative is construction-forced:
- `NOT_INDEPENDENT` needs an observed shared author.
- Q4 `NO_CLIENT_SET` is a structural git fact that QUESTIONS.md endorses ("a self-attested timestamp is not independence").
- Q8 `NO_LOCAL_ONLY` is factual.

## 6. Regression check

| Item | Result |
|---|---|
| Read-only safety | **OK.** Commands used: `realpath`, `sha256sum`, `cut`, `ls -A`, `mktemp -d`, `rm -rf $TMP` (l.35 and the trap), `mkdir -p $OUT`, `cd` once, `mv` within TMP, `sort/tr/comm/awk/grep`, and `find/sort/xargs sha256sum` in OUT. git calls are all read-only: `rev-parse` (inside-work-tree, bare, toplevel, absolute-git-dir, is-shallow, `--verify -q`), `config --get` ×2, `--version`, `for-each-ref`, `ls-tree`, `log`, `rev-list`, `cat-file commit/tag`. No fetch (partial clone refused, `GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1`), no index refresh (`core.fsmonitor=false`, `GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0`), no ref or config write, no diff or textconv. Every loop git call has its stdin redirected. |
| Determinism | **OK.** `LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC`, one C-sorted tip file, C-sorted sets, fixed channel order, sorted SHA256SUMS. No HEAD dependence. Residual: repo-local config readable (declared). `GIT_CONFIG`, `GIT_COMMON_DIR` and `GIT_GRAFT_FILE` are not unset, and `.git/info/grafts` is not neutralized (NB-2). |
| Config isolation (N4) | **OK as claimed.** NOSYSTEM, GLOBAL=/dev/null, `GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS`/`COUNT` unset. The wrapper is defined before the first git call (l.20 vs l.26), and every call, including those in subshells and pipelines, passes the eight `-c` overrides. `GIT_PAGER` beats `core.pager`. Residual: NB-2. |
| Self path before `cd` | **OK.** Resolved to absolute, `realpath`'d and hashed (l.16–18) before the one `cd` (l.38). |
| OUT refusal | **OK.** Required, absolute, `realpath -m`, refused when equal to or under the toplevel or the git dir (`"$d"/*` also matches `$d/`), must be empty or absent. An empty OUT cannot be an ancestor of the repo. TMP is refused inside the repo or OUT. N8 (common dir) is disclosed. |
| No identities / guard fails closed | **OK.** Every emitted file holds only counts, 16-hex ids, labels, the git version and hashes. git stderr stays in `$TMP/e`. Guard: rc 1 → `PASS`, rc 0 → `FAIL(n files)`, rc ≥ 2 → `FAIL(grep_rc)`, and both FAILs exit 1. Note: on FAIL the output stays in OUT, so the consumer must honour the exit code (NB-6). |
| Boundedness | **OK.** No file blob is read. Commit headers only (awk stops at the first blank line). Tag objects are read in full to find the trailing signature, which is a tag message rather than a header. That is minor and covered by the signature-presence justification. Cost is one full-history `log` per candidate path plus one `cat-file` per commit, with no cap (NB-8; performance, not safety). |
| `docs/knowledgeos/` exclusion | **OK.** Classifier (l.66, case-insensitive), E (`exclude,glob,icase`), and therefore `npaths` and W, which come from `cand`. N15 is disclosed. |
| Neutrality | **OK.** Headline tokens are neutral and defined in §5. No scoring. The by-type `SELF_ATTESTED` is the only substantive judgement embedded (BLK-1). |
| N9 / N12 / N6 / N3 / N14 | All verified as described. `-z` with `\001` carry, restored before pathspec and hashing. Tab-safe `index/substr` splitting. Ref scope limited. |

---

## Non-blocking

- **NB-1:** W, E and N_c run `git log` without `--full-history`. Default simplification prunes commits whose changes did not survive a merge. This can only reduce overlaps, so it can give an `INDEPENDENT…` that the `[aliases_unresolved]` qualifier does not cover. Add `--full-history`; with `--no-merges` the merge output does not change.
- **NB-2:** Environment hardening residuals:
  - `GIT_CONFIG` redirects `git config --get`. It could hide `extensions.partialClone`, which would bypass the capture-validity check, and it could misreport `core.hooksPath`.
  - `GIT_COMMON_DIR` redirects objects and refs.
  - `GIT_GRAFT_FILE` and `.git/info/grafts` rewrite history.

  Add the env vars to the `unset` list, and declare or refuse grafts.
- **NB-3:** The norm-register regex (l.89) has no trailing token boundary. `registration/`, `norms`, `normal…` and `decisionsupport…` match as long as some other K-STATUS token qualifies the path. `authoriz` alone is still unreachable (N13).
- **NB-4:** READMEs and other markdown inside the code roots count as executor work, which contradicts §3 ("READMEs … are not executor paths").
- **NB-5:** `cat-file commit | awk '…exit…'` under `pipefail`: for a commit object larger than the pipe buffer (~64 KiB), awk exits early, `cat-file` gets SIGPIPE, the pipeline fails and the signed commit is counted as unsigned. This extends N7.
- **NB-6:** When the identity guard fails, the files stay in OUT, and only the exit code and the `FAIL` line signal the problem. Declare this, or move OUT's content aside on FAIL.
- **NB-7:** In a linked worktree, K-LOCALHOOK checks `$GD/hooks` (per worktree), but the hooks live in the common dir. This is the N8 family.
- **NB-8:** There is no cap on per-path `git log` passes or per-commit `cat-file` spawns. A K-DEPLOY match on a large directory (e.g. `app/Services/Deploy/**`, `infra/**`) multiplies the runtime. Consider `cat-file --batch` and one `log --name-only` pass.
- **NB-9:** A single sweeping commit (repo-wide reformat or move) puts its author into W_c, N_c and E at once. That overlap is observed, not forced, but it should be disclosed next to the alias limit.
- **NB-10:** The positive Q7 can only be reached for K-DEPLOY, so the positive rests on one channel type. State this in §3. Also, CHANGELOG says ~169 lines; the script has 170 (trivial).

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scope_b.sh (r2) -- Protocol B scoping. Read-only; existence/metadata only. No network, no host access.
# Emits COUNTS ONLY: no names, emails, ref names, URLs or path strings leave TMP; paths -> 16-hex ids.
# The ONLY content read beyond existence/counts is commit/tag object headers for signature PRESENCE
# (Q1/Q2/Q7 for K-SIG strictly require it); no file blob is ever read.
# Usage (from anywhere inside the working clone):  OUT=/abs/empty/dir bash scope_b.sh
# Exit: 0 ok | 1 ok-with-unexpected-codes or identity-guard fail | 2 refused | 3 capture invalid
set -u -o pipefail
export LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null \
  GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1 GIT_GRAFT_FILE=/dev/null  # NB-2: neutralizes .git/info/grafts
unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES GIT_NAMESPACE GIT_COMMON_DIR \
  GIT_CONFIG GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS GIT_CONFIG_COUNT   # N4/NB-2: no injected config; repo-local config stays readable (declared)
die() { printf 'scope_b: %s\n' "$2" >&2; exit "$1"; }

# ---- resolve OWN absolute path and hash it BEFORE any cd (corrects earlier relative-BASH_SOURCE defect) ----
SELF="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"; case "$SELF" in /*) ;; *) SELF="$PWD/$SELF" ;; esac
SELF="$(realpath -- "$SELF")" || die 2 "cannot resolve own path"
SELFSHA="$(sha256sum < "$SELF" | cut -d' ' -f1)" || die 2 "cannot hash self"
# N4: these overrides are passed to EVERY git call
git() { command git -c core.quotepath=off -c log.mailmap=false -c color.ui=never -c log.follow=false -c diff.renames=false \
  -c log.decorate=false -c core.fsmonitor=false -c log.showSignature=false "$@"; }

# ---- preconditions (exit 2) ----
OUT="${OUT:-}"; [ -n "$OUT" ] || die 2 "OUT not set"
case "$OUT" in /*) ;; *) die 2 "OUT must be an absolute path" ;; esac
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null)" = true ] || die 2 "not inside a work tree"
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-bare-repository 2>/dev/null)" = false ] || die 2 "bare repository"
TOP="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || die 2 "no toplevel"
GD="$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir)" || die 2 "no git dir"
OUT="$(realpath -m -- "$OUT")" || die 2 "realpath OUT failed"
TOPR="$(realpath -- "$TOP")"; GDR="$(realpath -- "$GD")"
for d in "$TOPR" "$GDR"; do case "$OUT/" in "$d"/*) die 2 "OUT must be outside the work tree and .git" ;; esac; done
if [ -e "$OUT" ]; then { [ -d "$OUT" ] && [ -z "$(ls -A -- "$OUT")" ]; } || die 2 "OUT must be an empty directory"; fi
TMP="$(mktemp -d)" || die 2 "mktemp failed"; TMP="$(realpath -- "$TMP")"
case "$TMP/" in "$TOPR"/*|"$GDR"/*|"$OUT"/*) rm -rf -- "$TMP"; die 2 "TMPDIR must be outside the repo and OUT" ;; esac
trap 'rm -rf -- "$TMP"' EXIT
mkdir -p -- "$OUT" || die 2 "cannot create OUT"
cd -- "$TOP" || die 2 "cannot cd to the toplevel"   # the one and only cd; self already resolved+hashed above

ERR="$OUT/00_errors.tsv"; : > "$ERR"; : > "$TMP/e"
ok() { local l="$1" rc="$2" a; shift 2; for a in "$@"; do [ "$rc" = "$a" ] && return 0; done; printf '%s\t%s\n' "$l" "$rc" >> "$ERR"; return 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$SELFSHA" > "$OUT/00_script.sha256"
printf 'git_version\t%s\nrepo_local_config\tREADABLE(not isolated; declared)\n' "$(git --version)" > "$OUT/00_env.tsv"
ND=NOT_DETERMINABLE_BY_EXISTENCE_CHECK; IND=INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE
finish() { ( cd -- "$OUT" && find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print | sort | xargs -r -d '\n' sha256sum ) > "$OUT/SHA256SUMS"; exit "$1"; }

# ---- capture validity + THE ONE tip set (B1/N5/N12) -> tracked path universe at tips ----
SH="$(git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository 2>/dev/null)"; ok env.shallow $? 0
PC="$(git config --get extensions.partialClone)"; ok cfg.partialClone $? 0 1
if [ "$SH" != false ] || [ -n "$PC" ]; then printf 'overall\tCAPTURE_INVALID\n' > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; finish 3; fi
# tip set = refs/heads/**, refs/remotes/**, refs/tags/** only (never refs/stash, refs/notes/**); tags peeled; commit-type only
git for-each-ref --format='%(objectname) %(objecttype)' refs/heads refs/remotes refs/tags > "$TMP/refs" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok refs $? 0
: > "$TMP/t0"
while read -r o ty; do case "$ty" in commit) printf '%s\n' "$o" >> "$TMP/t0" ;;
  tag) git rev-parse --verify -q "$o^{commit}" < /dev/null >> "$TMP/t0" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok peel $? 0 1 ;; esac; done < "$TMP/refs"
sort -u "$TMP/t0" > "$TMP/tips"
[ -s "$TMP/tips" ] || { printf 'overall\tCAPTURE_INVALID\n' > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; finish 3; }
: > "$TMP/paths"   # N9: read with -z; an embedded newline is carried as \001 and restored before any pathspec/hash use
while IFS= read -r t; do git ls-tree -r -z --name-only --full-tree "$t" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | tr '\n\0' '\001\n' >> "$TMP/paths"
  ok lstree "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0; done < "$TMP/tips"

# The ONLY content read beyond existence/counts is commit/tag object headers for signature PRESENCE
# (Q1/Q2/Q7 for K-SIG strictly require it); no file blob is ever read.
# Usage (from anywhere inside the working clone):  OUT=/abs/empty/dir bash scope_b.sh
# Exit: 0 ok | 1 ok-with-unexpected-codes or identity-guard fail | 2 refused | 3 capture invalid
set -u -o pipefail
export LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null \

unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES GIT_NAMESPACE \
  GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS GIT_CONFIG_COUNT   # N4: no injected config; repo-local config stays readable (declared)
die() { printf 'scope_b: %s\n' "$2" >&2; exit "$1"; }

# ---- resolve OWN absolute path and hash it BEFORE any cd (corrects earlier relative-BASH_SOURCE defect) ----
SELF="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"; case "$SELF" in /*) ;; *) SELF="$PWD/$SELF" ;; esac
SELF="$(realpath -- "$SELF")" || die 2 "cannot resolve own path"
SELFSHA="$(sha256sum < "$SELF" | cut -d' ' -f1)" || die 2 "cannot hash self"
# N4: these overrides are passed to EVERY git call
git() { command git -c core.quotepath=off -c log.mailmap=false -c color.ui=never -c log.follow=false -c diff.renames=false \
  -c log.decorate=false -c core.fsmonitor=false -c log.showSignature=false "$@"; }

# ---- preconditions (exit 2) ----
OUT="${OUT:-}"; [ -n "$OUT" ] || die 2 "OUT not set"
case "$OUT" in /*) ;; *) die 2 "OUT must be an absolute path" ;; esac
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null)" = true ] || die 2 "not inside a work tree"
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-bare-repository 2>/dev/null)" = false ] || die 2 "bare repository"
TOP="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || die 2 "no toplevel"
GD="$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir)" || die 2 "no git dir"

{ p=$0; q=tolower(p); b=q; sub(/.*\//,"",b)
  if (q ~ /^docs\/knowledgeos\//) next
  if (q ~ /^[.]github\/workflows\// || q==".gitlab-ci.yml" || b=="jenkinsfile" || q ~ /^[.]circleci\// || q=="azure-pipelines.yml" || q==".drone.yml" || q=="bitbucket-pipelines.yml" || q ~ /^[.]woodpecker/) print "K-CI\t" p
  if (q ~ /^[.]githooks\// || q ~ /^[.]husky\// || q==".pre-commit-config.yaml" || b=="lefthook.yml" || b==".lefthook.yml") print "K-HOOK\t" p
  if (b=="codeowners") print "K-CODEOWNERS\t" p
  e=""; if (b ~ /[.][^.]+$/){e=b; sub(/.*[.]/,"",e)}
  docx=(e=="md"||e=="markdown"||e=="txt"||e=="rst"||e=="json"||e=="yaml"||e=="yml"||e=="toml"||e=="csv"||e=="tsv")
  if (docx && q ~ /(^|\/)(program_status|status|rulings?|register|registry|decisions?|adoptions?|approvals?|signoffs?|progress|inforce|norm)([._/-]|$)/) print "K-STATUS\t" p
  if (q ~ /(^|\/)(deploy|deployment|release|environment|env|infra|terraform)([._/-]|$)/ || e=="tfstate") print "K-DEPLOY\t" p }' \
  "$TMP/paths" | sort -u > "$TMP/cand"

# ---- B3/B4: executor set E = AUTHOR e-mails (%ae only) of non-merge commits touching the Protocol-A r1 CODE/TEST
# ROOTS over the full history of the tip set; every candidate-channel GLOB pattern and docs/knowledgeos/** excluded.
ROOTS=( app routes database resources config bootstrap lang public tests )
CHG=( '.github/workflows/**' '.gitlab-ci.yml' '**/jenkinsfile' '.circleci/**' 'azure-pipelines.yml' '.drone.yml' 'bitbucket-pipelines.yml'
  '.woodpecker*' '.woodpecker*/**' '.githooks/**' '.husky/**' '.pre-commit-config.yaml' '**/lefthook.yml' '**/.lefthook.yml' '**/codeowners' '**/*.tfstate' )
for t in program_status status ruling rulings register registry decision decisions adoption adoptions approval approvals signoff signoffs progress inforce norm; do
  for x in md markdown txt rst json yaml yml toml csv tsv; do CHG+=( "**/$t.$x" "**/$t[._-]*.$x" "**/$t/**/*.$x" "**/$t[._-]*/**/*.$x" ); done; done
for t in deploy deployment release environment env infra terraform; do CHG+=( "**/$t" "**/$t/**" "**/$t[._-]*" "**/$t[._-]*/**" ); done
PS=( ); for r in "${ROOTS[@]}"; do PS+=( ":(literal)$r" ); done
PS+=( ':(exclude,glob,icase)docs/knowledgeos/**' ); for g in "${CHG[@]}"; do PS+=( ":(exclude,glob,icase)$g" ); done
git log --stdin --no-merges --format='%ae' -- "${PS[@]}" < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/E"
ok writers.exec "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0; nE=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/E")
# B2: norm-register paths (K-STATUS rulings/register subset); N_c = their authors MINUS candidate c's own paths
awk -F'\t' '$1=="K-STATUS"{p=$0; sub(/^[^\t]*\t/,"",p); if (tolower(p) ~ /(^|\/)(rulings?|register|registry|decisions?|norm|inforce|authoriz)/) print p}' \
  "$TMP/cand" | sort -u > "$TMP/npaths"

# ---- per-channel metrics (counts only; W, commits, N_c all via --stdin over the one tip set) + path-id map ----
: > "$OUT/61_path_ids.tsv"; : > "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"
for ch in K-CI K-HOOK K-CODEOWNERS K-STATUS K-DEPLOY; do
  awk -v c="$ch" 'index($0, c "\t")==1{print substr($0, length(c)+2)}' "$TMP/cand" | sort -u > "$TMP/cp"
  np=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/cp"); : > "$TMP/W"; nc=0
  while IFS= read -r p; do pr="${p//$'\001'/$'\n'}"
    id="$(printf '%s' "$pr" | sha256sum | cut -c1-16)"; printf '%s\t%s\n' "$id" "$ch" >> "$OUT/61_path_ids.tsv"
    git log --stdin --no-merges --format='%ae' -- ":(literal)$pr" < "$TMP/tips" > "$TMP/w1" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok "w.$id" $? 0
    nc=$((nc + $(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/w1"))); cat "$TMP/w1" >> "$TMP/W"
  done < "$TMP/cp"
  tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' < "$TMP/W" | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/Wu"
  comm -23 "$TMP/npaths" "$TMP/cp" > "$TMP/ncp"; nnp=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/ncp"); : > "$TMP/Nc"
  if [ -s "$TMP/ncp" ]; then NPS=( ); while IFS= read -r p; do NPS+=( ":(literal)${p//$'\001'/$'\n'}" ); done < "$TMP/ncp"
    git log --stdin --no-merges --format='%ae' -- "${NPS[@]}" < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/Nc"
    ok "writers.norm.$ch" "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0; fi
  nw=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/Wu"); nn=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/Nc")
  oe=$(comm -12 "$TMP/Wu" "$TMP/E" | awk 'END{print NR}'); on=$(comm -12 "$TMP/Wu" "$TMP/Nc" | awk 'END{print NR}')
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$ch" "$np" "$nc" "$nw" "$oe" "$on" "$nnp" "$nn" >> "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"
done

# ---- K-SIG: signature PRESENCE only (justified object-header read; keyring not consulted) ----
git rev-list --stdin < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | sort -u > "$TMP/allc"; ok revlist "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0
nS=0; while IFS= read -r c; do
  git cat-file commit "$c" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | awk '/^$/{exit} /^gpgsig/{s=1} END{exit (s?0:1)}' && nS=$((nS+1)); done < "$TMP/allc"
nTS=0; while IFS= read -r line; do set -- $line; [ "${2:-}" = tag ] || continue
  git cat-file tag "$1" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | grep -qE '^-----BEGIN (PGP|SSH) SIGNATURE-----$' && nTS=$((nTS+1)); done < "$TMP/refs"
printf 'commits_total\t%s\ncommits_signed\t%s\ntags_signed\t%s\n' "$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/allc")" "$nS" "$nTS" > "$OUT/58_signatures.tsv"

# ---- K-LOCALHOOK: local .git/hooks presence (LOCAL_ONLY, unversioned) ----
HOOKS="applypatch-msg commit-msg post-checkout post-commit post-merge post-receive post-update pre-applypatch pre-commit pre-merge-commit pre-push pre-rebase pre-receive prepare-commit-msg update"
nh=0; for hk in $HOOKS; do [ -e "$GD/hooks/$hk" ] && nh=$((nh+1)); done
hp=unset; git config --get core.hooksPath > /dev/null 2>&1 && hp=set
printf 'standard_hooks_present\t%s\ncore_hooksPath\t%s\n' "$nh" "$hp" > "$OUT/56_local_hooks.tsv"

# ---- answers Q1..Q8 (deterministic; every outcome reachable; never a forced negative) ----
NA7='NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)'
{
printf '#channel\tQ1_exists\tQ2_records\tQ3_controls\tQ4_ts_independent\tQ5_norm_at_t\tQ6_complete\tQ7_independent\tQ8_reproducible\n'
awk -F'\t' -v ND="$ND" -v IND="$IND" -v nE="$nE" 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"; na="NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)"}
{ ch=$1; np=$2+0; nw=$4+0; oe=$5+0; on=$6+0; nnp=$7+0; nn=$8+0
  if (np==0){ print ch,"NOT_EVIDENCED_AT_TIPS",na,na,na,na,na,na,na; next }
  cfg=(ch=="K-CI"||ch=="K-HOOK"||ch=="K-CODEOWNERS")
  q2=cfg?"CONFIG_RULE(by type; content not read)":(ch=="K-STATUS"?"STATUS/NORM_RECORD(by type; content not read)":"STATE_RECORD_BY_TYPE(content not read)")
  ov="overlap_exec=" oe ";overlap_norm=" (nnp>0 ? on : "NA")
  if (ch=="K-STATUS") q7="SELF_ATTESTED[norm_register;" ov "]"
  else if (nnp==0) q7=IND "[no_norm_source_distinct_from_candidate;" ov "]"
  else if (cfg) q7=IND "[mechanism_host_enforced_unobservable;" ov "]"
  else if (nw==0 || nn==0 || nE==0) q7=IND "[empty_set;W=" nw ";N_c=" nn ";E=" nE "]"
  else if (on>0) q7="NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_norm=" on "]"
  else if (oe>0) q7="NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_exec=" oe "]"
  else q7="INDEPENDENT_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL[aliases_unresolved]"
  print ch,"YES_IN_CAPTURE",q2,"CONTROLLED_BY_WRITERS[n=" nw "]","NO_CLIENT_SET(git recording times are client-generated)",ND,ND "[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]",q7,"YES_LOCAL(content-addressed; rerunnable on same ref set)" }' \
  "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"
read -r nC nSg nTg < <(awk -F'\t' '{v[$1]=$2} END{print v["commits_total"]+0, v["commits_signed"]+0, v["tags_signed"]+0}' "$OUT/58_signatures.tsv")
if [ "$nSg" -gt 0 ] || [ "$nTg" -gt 0 ]; then
  printf 'K-SIG\tYES_IN_CAPTURE\tIDENTITY_ATTESTATION(presence only; not verified)\t%s(keyring not consulted)\tNO_CLIENT_SET(signer clock)\t%s\t%s[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]\t%s(signatures not verified)\tYES_LOCAL(presence only)\n' "$ND" "$ND" "$ND" "$IND"
else printf "K-SIG\tNOT_EVIDENCED_AT_TIPS\t$NA7\n"; fi
read -r hn hpv < <(awk -F'\t' '{v[$1]=$2} END{print v["standard_hooks_present"]+0, v["core_hooksPath"]}' "$OUT/56_local_hooks.tsv")
if [ "$hn" -gt 0 ] || [ "$hpv" = set ]; then
  printf 'K-LOCALHOOK\tYES_LOCAL_ONLY\tCONFIG_RULE(by type; content not read)\tLOCAL_MACHINE\tNONE\t%s\t%s[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]\t%s(local, unversioned)\tNO_LOCAL_ONLY(not versioned; not reproducible from the ref set)\n' "$ND" "$ND" "$IND"
else printf "K-LOCALHOOK\tNOT_EVIDENCED_LOCALLY\t$NA7\n"; fi
for hc in K-HOST-AUDIT K-HOST-BRANCHPROT K-HOST-PR-APPROVALS K-CI-RUNS K-HOST-MEMBERS; do
  printf '%s\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\n' "$hc"; done
} > "$OUT/70_answers.tsv"

# ---- overall: headline COMPUTED from the per-channel Q7 values (N2/N14) + fail-closed identity guard (N6) ----
q7n() { awk -F'\t' -v r="$1" 'NR>1 && $8 ~ r {c++} END{print c+0}' "$OUT/70_answers.tsv"; }
nI=$(q7n '^INDEPENDENT_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL'); nD=$(q7n '^INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE'); nX=$(q7n '^NOT_INDEPENDENT'); nA=$(q7n '^SELF_ATTESTED')
if [ "$nI" -gt 0 ]; then HL=LOCAL_INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATE_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL; elif [ "$nD" -gt 0 ]; then HL=LOCAL_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE
elif [ $((nX+nA)) -gt 0 ]; then HL=LOCAL_NO_INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATE_OBSERVED; else HL=LOCAL_NO_CANDIDATE_EVIDENCED; fi
nNE=$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1 && $2 ~ /^NOT_EVIDENCED/{c++} END{print c+0}' "$OUT/70_answers.tsv")
printf 'headline\t%s\ncomplete_vs_host\tNOT_SHOWN\nindependent_at_identity_count_level\t%s\nopen_local_candidates\t%s\nnot_independent_by_overlap\t%s\nself_attested\t%s\nnot_evidenced\t%s\nhost_channels\t5\n' \
  "$HL" "$nI" "$nD" "$nX" "$nA" "$nNE" > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"
code=0; [ -s "$ERR" ] && code=1
grep -rlE '@|BEGIN (PGP|SSH) SIGNATURE' -- "$OUT" > "$TMP/hit" 2>/dev/null; g=$?
if [ "$g" -eq 1 ]; then printf 'identity_guard\tPASS\n' >> "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"
elif [ "$g" -eq 0 ]; then printf 'identity_guard\tFAIL(%s files)\n' "$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/hit")" >> "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; code=1
else printf 'identity_guard\tFAIL(grep_rc=%s)\n' "$g" >> "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; code=1; fi
finish "$code"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scope_b.sh (r2) -- Protocol B scoping. Read-only; existence/metadata only. No network, no host access.
# Emits COUNTS ONLY: no names, emails, ref names, URLs or path strings leave TMP; paths -> 16-hex ids.
# The ONLY content read beyond existence/counts is commit/tag object headers for signature PRESENCE
# (Q1/Q2/Q7 for K-SIG strictly require it); no file blob is ever read.
# Usage (from anywhere inside the working clone):  OUT=/abs/empty/dir bash scope_b.sh
# Exit: 0 ok | 1 ok-with-unexpected-codes or identity-guard fail | 2 refused | 3 capture invalid
set -u -o pipefail
export LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null \
  GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1 GIT_GRAFT_FILE=/dev/null  # NB-2: neutralizes .git/info/grafts
unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES GIT_NAMESPACE GIT_COMMON_DIR \
  GIT_CONFIG GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS GIT_CONFIG_COUNT   # N4/NB-2: no injected config; repo-local config stays readable (declared)
die() { printf 'scope_b: %s\n' "$2" >&2; exit "$1"; }

# ---- resolve OWN absolute path and hash it BEFORE any cd (corrects earlier relative-BASH_SOURCE defect) ----
SELF="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"; case "$SELF" in /*) ;; *) SELF="$PWD/$SELF" ;; esac
SELF="$(realpath -- "$SELF")" || die 2 "cannot resolve own path"
SELFSHA="$(sha256sum < "$SELF" | cut -d' ' -f1)" || die 2 "cannot hash self"
# N4: these overrides are passed to EVERY git call
git() { command git -c core.quotepath=off -c log.mailmap=false -c color.ui=never -c log.follow=false -c diff.renames=false \
  -c log.decorate=false -c core.fsmonitor=false -c log.showSignature=false "$@"; }

# ---- preconditions (exit 2) ----
OUT="${OUT:-}"; [ -n "$OUT" ] || die 2 "OUT not set"
case "$OUT" in /*) ;; *) die 2 "OUT must be an absolute path" ;; esac
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null)" = true ] || die 2 "not inside a work tree"
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-bare-repository 2>/dev/null)" = false ] || die 2 "bare repository"
TOP="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || die 2 "no toplevel"
GD="$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir)" || die 2 "no git dir"
OUT="$(realpath -m -- "$OUT")" || die 2 "realpath OUT failed"
TOPR="$(realpath -- "$TOP")"; GDR="$(realpath -- "$GD")"
for d in "$TOPR" "$GDR"; do case "$OUT/" in "$d"/*) die 2 "OUT must be outside the work tree and .git" ;; esac; done
if [ -e "$OUT" ]; then { [ -d "$OUT" ] && [ -z "$(ls -A -- "$OUT")" ]; } || die 2 "OUT must be an empty directory"; fi
TMP="$(mktemp -d)" || die 2 "mktemp failed"; TMP="$(realpath -- "$TMP")"
case "$TMP/" in "$TOPR"/*|"$GDR"/*|"$OUT"/*) rm -rf -- "$TMP"; die 2 "TMPDIR must be outside the repo and OUT" ;; esac
trap 'rm -rf -- "$TMP"' EXIT
mkdir -p -- "$OUT" || die 2 "cannot create OUT"
cd -- "$TOP" || die 2 "cannot cd to the toplevel"   # the one and only cd; self already resolved+hashed above

ERR="$OUT/00_errors.tsv"; : > "$ERR"; : > "$TMP/e"
ok() { local l="$1" rc="$2" a; shift 2; for a in "$@"; do [ "$rc" = "$a" ] && return 0; done; printf '%s\t%s\n' "$l" "$rc" >> "$ERR"; return 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$SELFSHA" > "$OUT/00_script.sha256"
printf 'git_version\t%s\nrepo_local_config\tREADABLE(not isolated; declared)\n' "$(git --version)" > "$OUT/00_env.tsv"
ND=NOT_DETERMINABLE_BY_EXISTENCE_CHECK; IND=INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE
finish() { ( cd -- "$OUT" && find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print | sort | xargs -r -d '\n' sha256sum ) > "$OUT/SHA256SUMS"; exit "$1"; }

# ---- capture validity + THE ONE tip set (B1/N5/N12) -> tracked path universe at tips ----
SH="$(git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository 2>/dev/null)"; ok env.shallow $? 0
PC="$(git config --get extensions.partialClone)"; ok cfg.partialClone $? 0 1
if [ "$SH" != false ] || [ -n "$PC" ]; then printf 'overall\tCAPTURE_INVALID\n' > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; finish 3; fi
# tip set = refs/heads/**, refs/remotes/**, refs/tags/** only (never refs/stash, refs/notes/**); tags peeled; commit-type only
git for-each-ref --format='%(objectname) %(objecttype)' refs/heads refs/remotes refs/tags > "$TMP/refs" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok refs $? 0
: > "$TMP/t0"
while read -r o ty; do case "$ty" in commit) printf '%s\n' "$o" >> "$TMP/t0" ;;
  tag) git rev-parse --verify -q "$o^{commit}" < /dev/null >> "$TMP/t0" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok peel $? 0 1 ;; esac; done < "$TMP/refs"
sort -u "$TMP/t0" > "$TMP/tips"
[ -s "$TMP/tips" ] || { printf 'overall\tCAPTURE_INVALID\n' > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; finish 3; }
: > "$TMP/paths"   # N9: read with -z; an embedded newline is carried as \001 and restored before any pathspec/hash use
while IFS= read -r t; do git ls-tree -r -z --name-only --full-tree "$t" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | tr '\n\0' '\001\n' >> "$TMP/paths"
  ok lstree "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0; done < "$TMP/tips"
sort -u "$TMP/paths" > "$TMP/pu"; mv "$TMP/pu" "$TMP/paths"

# ---- classify candidate channels (bounded vocabulary; docs/knowledgeos excluded) ----
# BLK-1/NB-3: K-NORMREG (register regex, trailing token boundary) and K-STATUS (the remaining status records) are disjoint
awk -F'\t' '
{ p=$0; q=tolower(p); b=q; sub(/.*\//,"",b)
  if (q ~ /^docs\/knowledgeos\//) next
  if (q ~ /^[.]github\/workflows\// || q==".gitlab-ci.yml" || b=="jenkinsfile" || q ~ /^[.]circleci\// || q=="azure-pipelines.yml" || q==".drone.yml" || q=="bitbucket-pipelines.yml" || q ~ /^[.]woodpecker/) print "K-CI\t" p
  if (q ~ /^[.]githooks\// || q ~ /^[.]husky\// || q==".pre-commit-config.yaml" || b=="lefthook.yml" || b==".lefthook.yml") print "K-HOOK\t" p
  if (b=="codeowners") print "K-CODEOWNERS\t" p
  e=""; if (b ~ /[.][^.]+$/){e=b; sub(/.*[.]/,"",e)}
  docx=(e=="md"||e=="markdown"||e=="txt"||e=="rst"||e=="json"||e=="yaml"||e=="yml"||e=="toml"||e=="csv"||e=="tsv")
